article_vibe_coding.summary: Describe an app to an AI, get working code, ship it tonight. Vibe coding is real and it works — until it doesn't. This article explains what is actually happening when software appears from prompts, where technical debt hides in AI-generated code, and why the person who ships is still responsible for what they shipped.
article_vibe_coding.title: Vibe Coding and the Illusion of Understanding
